projects.title: Wing Structure Assembly Jig Design
projects.description: Designed and developed an assembly jig for positioning and assembling aircraft wing structural components while ensuring accurate alignment of ribs, spars, and skin panels.
projects.challenge: Ensure accurate alignment of ribs, spars, and skin panels.
projects.solution: Implemented rotatable contour plate system, reinforced high-rigidity clamping architecture, and modular rectangular interface plates.

projects.title: BIW (Body-in-White) Welding Fixture
projects.description: Designed and developed a precision Body-in-White (BIW) welding fixture engineered for loading, unloading, and spot welding of an automotive cross-member assembly.
projects.challenge: Precise loading, unloading, and spot welding of cross-member assembly.
projects.solution: Applied 3-2-1 locating principle, balanced clamp positioning for uniform pressure, and distortion-free welding support.

story.heading: Precision by Design. Excellence by Commitment.
story.content: DAVS Integrated Engineering Solutions is a specialized Mechanical CAD and Tool Designing firm focused on delivering high-accuracy engineering solutions for manufacturing industries. The company has extensive experience in HAL tool designing, demonstrating its capability to meet stringent aerospace quality and performance standards.
story.mission: By combining strong production process knowledge with dimensional control expertise, DAVS develops robust, cost-effective, and manufacturing-ready engineering solutions.
story.vision: DAVS follows a structured and integrated design approach, from concept development to final documentation, ensuring precision, efficiency, and reliability in every project.
